review_dimensions.evidence: The closed projection schema requires every authority, identity, temporal, membership, proof, lineage, read-only and interoperability section. Missing sections produce explicit reasons; no nearby repository value is reconstructed or defaulted.

Bindable is reached only after closed-schema validation, external registry verification, projection digest parity, exact point-in-time ordering, finality/completeness proof validation, immutable membership binding, P.2A material snapshot validation and external authority-root equality.

Both synthetic runtime and persisted-row shapes matching current repository formats terminate as not_bindable. Their exact eighteen missing-proof reasons are frozen and no real row or private identity is present.
The repository-shaped compatibility boundary emits exactly the frozen eighteen-code set. All multi-reason paths pass through a unique lexicographic sort before terminal digest construction.

The public request contains projection and expected source-snapshot identities only. The expected registry anchor and material callback arrive through dependency-injected external authority; a self-consistent caller registry replacement fails against the independently supplied anchor digest.

Observed material is canonicalized to plain data, accepted input is structured-cloned and deeply frozen, and the emitted bindable projection and Q.1 payload are deeply frozen. Post-verification source mutation cannot alter the result.

Canonical integer strings are compared with BigInt and enforce decision < outcome start <= outcome end <= outcome finalization <= capture <= evidence cutoff. Predictor cutoff must equal decision time; equality and one-nanosecond threat boundaries are tested without float conversion.

Opportunity identity, immutable membership digest and immutable=true are mandatory. The same identity/digest is projected into the Q.1 payload and reconciled through the verified P.2A authority material before Q.1 ready, P.2A captured or O.2A joined can occur.

Material, registry and projection-input sections carry canonical observed digests, explicit dispositions, expected bindings, verifier identity/version and sorted reasons. Absent values use a canonical sentinel.

Failure identity binds taxonomy, request, authority binding, per-section observed provenance and reasons. Different rejected observed inputs produce distinct failure/result digests, while a fresh deterministic rebuild rejects self-consistent candidate tampering.
The single fully synthetic successor produces bindable, then Q.1 ready, P.2A captured and O.2A joined through the versioned public contracts without special-case adapters or caller authority claims.
Disabled and kill-switch paths return precomputed deeply frozen terminal values before request canonicalization, cloning, authority lookup, projection, Q/P/O calls or per-call digest work.

Implementation imports only committed diagnostic context, P.2A and Q.1 contracts. Scans found no provider, database, writer, persistence, migration, dependency, lockfile, Action 665/666 implementation or live-ranking path.
All 24 scenarios and the interoperability flow are synthetic. Outputs remain diagnostic, shadow and read-only with canonical, model, training, promotion, causal and live eligibility disabled.
